highlights: first floor apartment in town centre
summary: A one bedroomed first floor apartment in this town centre complex. With parking. Low service charge.
description:
With no forward chain this first floor apartment is conveniently situated in the town centre.

With a low service charge of £46 per month which includes water rates.

The communal entance and stairs leads up to the flat which has a private entrance hall with cupboard housing the water tank. An open plan style living room and kitchen with integrated oven/hob, washer dryer and fridge.

One bedroom and bathroom with bath and electric shower over.

A parking space in the courtyard.

Services Mains electric, water and drains are connected, but neither these services nor any boilers or heaters have been tested.

Key Information: • Standard construction. • We understand that broadband and mobile telephone reception are available. For an indication of speeds and supply please see the OFCOM website:

Leasehold property with service charge of approx £46 per month including water charge. Any additional work required is calculated on squared meterage of the flat.

New uPVC windows fitted in 2022. Storage heaters.
